description: Concept selection from Census metadata only. No microdata examined. Labels here identify concepts; exact per-release labels, types, codes and ranges remain in each release evidence.
limitations: Social Security reasons are indicator fields; no type-specific amount is inferred from the gross monthly total.
IRA and Keogh balances are combined; 401(k), 403(b), 503(b), and Thrift Savings Plan balances are combined.
TYRENTRY codes have different grouped-year intervals across releases; the codes do not identify exact arrival dates.
Roster, housing tenure and December shelter payments provide inputs only; they do not establish SSI one-third-reduction or in-kind-support eligibility.
Disability survey reports do not constitute an SSI disability determination.
Citizenship, nativity and grouped entry year do not establish qualified-noncitizen status or qualifying quarters.
No separate RMD identifier or retirement-fund lump-sum-access/periodic-payment eligibility has been verified.
Concept availability uses the release API plus Census public-use schema; admission also requires exact release dictionary/API label, type and domain verification in the reader registry.

release_changes.change: Absent through 2020; present from 2021. Legacy combined distributions remain separate concepts.
2018-2020 metadata spells KEOGH; 2021 onward spells Keogh. Published combined account category remains unchanged.
Grouped year codes and interval labels change each release; for example 2016 means 2015-2016 in 2022 and exact 2016 in 2024-2025. Preserve release-specific code labels.
Available in 2022-2024 and suppressed in 2025. Other roster and business slots also have release-specific suppression; crosswalk nulls refuse them.
Absent or suppressed in early releases; available in later releases only as recorded in release_crosswalk.
